scope: LAN editor presentation and inverse conversion; router save/apply/rollback executors unchanged
root_cause: Raw CIDR addresses were copied directly to an editor with a separate mask control.
behavior: Uniform CIDR addresses display bare IPv4 addresses with the derived shared netmask.
Untouched address and mask restore their exact original scalar/list and missing/empty mask representation.
Edited addresses and mask serialize back to the original CIDR storage family; legacy separate fields remain separate.
Independent per-address prefixes and invalid original values stay intact instead of losing information.

compatibility_sources.finding: Old releases use address and netmask; 25.12 uses CIDR lists. Conversion follows actual values, not a guessed version or hardware.

validation.real_lua_persistence: passed for legacy and modern device bindings and both address storage families
validation.rendering: dark and light screenshots inspected; no geometry or styling changes
validation.debian12: Shared core imported and executed successfully; PySide6 absent, GUI acceptance pending.

limits: Running app must restart to load the source change.
